# JT49 vendoring

Pinned upstream: `jotego/jt49`, revision `47301ed51374d6d41db4db846b7643fecf75e417`. Original author: Jose Tejada Gomez; retained source headers identify additional contributors. Upstream terms are GPL-3.0-or-later.

The seven HDL files, LICENSE and README are exact pinned upstream copies. The project's reduced-function tone derivative is `../../thepit_tone.sv`, using unchanged `jt49_cen` and `jt49_div`. The active source list is the project-specific QIP at the repository root; no Git submodule is required by this self-contained export.

The upstream README's optional `hdl/jt49.yaml`, `syn/quartus/jt49.qip`, documentation and simulation links describe the complete upstream repository. Those optional files are not supplied in this selected source copy and are not dependencies of this core. The README is preserved verbatim rather than rewriting upstream links.

Documentation correction: 2026-10-11. No JT49 HDL or licence text changed.
